segments.text: A female schoolgirl inhabiting an academy in the Hinomoto region. She evolves into an office lady or mother with age.
They generally act in groups and possess strong territorial instincts. Like most schoolgirls, she cohabits with a mother in her dwelling.
It is said nothing can withstand a large flail. Those deceived by her delicate appearance end up as stains on iron balls, time and again.
She views males as disgusting, filthy creatures, just as she was taught, and “approaching requires extreme caution.”
【Lion King's Strategy Memo】
"An overly competitive female. Exploit her strong wariness and sense of shame. If you can use them skillfully, victory will be within reach!"
From official site
ヒノモト地方の学園に生息する、ジョガクセイという雌。
年齢と共にオーエルやハハオヤに進化する。
基本的に群れで行動しており、縄張り意識が強い。
ジョガクセイの多くがそうであるように、住処でハハオヤと同居している。
大きなフレイルに砕けぬ物はないと言われている。
見た目の華奢な感じに惑わされて、鉄球の染みになるものが後を絶たない。
男に対しては、教育されたとおりキモくて汚い生き物と思っており、
近づく際は細心の注意が必要。

segments.text: A female of an ultra-rare species from the Kingdom of Shutrend. She is regarded with respect by others as the heir to the queen of the pack.

Though young, she possesses the bearing befitting the next queen, yet as an individual, she remains immature in many ways, revealing vulnerabilities in her actions. She always moves in a pack, rarely showing any opportunity for solitary action.

“Her guard-type transformable mechanical doll, Kuhen, mercilessly eliminates any suspicious individuals who approach. It is said she has no equal in long-range combat. Treating her like a child will enrage her, making her impossible to handle—caution is advised.”
【Lion King Strategy Memo】
“There's a saying: ‘To shoot the general, first shoot his horse.’ That's exactly right. If you underestimate the little brat, you'll get hurt—it's the same in any era!”
From official site
シュトレンド王国の超希少種の雌。
群れの女王を受け継ぐ者として周りから一目置かれている。
若年ながら、次期女王としての風格を兼ね備えてはいるが、
個体としては未成熟な面も多く、行動の端々に隙がある。
常に群れをなしており、単独行動の隙をなかなか見せない。
護衛用変型機械人形クーヘンが近づく不審者を容赦なく排除する。
遠距離戦では肩を並べる物はいないと言われている。
子供扱いすると激昂し手が点けられなくなるので注意されたし。

「わらわは次期女王フィーリア・ディ・ミュルフォンなるぞ！　おまえのようなげせんのものが触れてよい身ではない！」
An elf warrior dwelling in the deep green Mig Forest. Possessing a strong sense of kinship, they treat all who live in the forest as family.
Though generally gentle-natured, they become the forest's guardians, thoroughly eliminating any malicious intruders they encounter.
With a greatbow nearly as tall as themselves in hand, they are speedsters who move freely throughout the woods.
Approach carelessly, and their lightning-fast arrow will pierce your body. For some reason, they hold an extraordinary interest in the cats of the Genda world.
【Lion King's Strategy Memo】
"Tits. As you can see, this female's defining feature—her breasts—is also her weakness. Thoroughly exploiting a female's weakness is the fundamental principle of finding a bride!"
From official site
緑深きミグフォレストに棲息するエルフ族の戦士。
身内意識が強く、森で生活するものをすべて家族として扱っている。
基本的に大人しい性格だが、ひとたび悪意ある侵入者を見つければ、
徹底的に排除する森の護り手的存在。
身の丈ほどもある大弓を片手に、森の中を自由自在に移動するスピードスター。
不用意に近づけば、神速の一矢がその身を貫くことだろう。
なぜか、ジェンダ世界の猫に並々ならぬ興味を持っている。

A witch dwelling in Mig Forest, appearing and vanishing without warning. She is also a beast-person with jet-black wings like a crow.
She flies through the skies as if they belong to her, wandering wherever her whims take her, making it difficult to ambush her at any specific location.
An all-rounder who uses magic at range and claws in close combat. Once she sends you flying through the air, all that's left is to sit back and watch yourself get roasted.
Currently bored, as no male has caught her interest. Though a rare beast-woman witch, her origins remain shrouded in mystery.
【Lion King's Strategy Memo】
"A troublesome female with ranged attacks & wings that let her soar freely through the air. Capture her with a special trap, force her into close combat, and charm her silly!"
From official site
ミグフォレストに住む、神出鬼没の魔女。
カラスのような漆黒の羽根を持つ獣人でもある。
我が物顔で空を飛び、気の向くままに放浪しているため、
特定の場所で待ち伏せるのは難しい。
遠距離では魔法、近距離では爪を使うオールラウンダー。
空中に飛ばれてしまったが最期、後は指をくわえて上手に焼かれるのを待つしかない。
今のところ興味を惹かれる雄がおらず退屈している。
獣人の魔女と珍しい存在でありながら、その出自は謎に包まれている。

A female of the Narukami bloodline. Wandering the world in search of the seed of the strongest male to ensure the prosperity of her clan.
Though possessing both offensive and defensive capabilities, she dwelled in a closed-off land and remains ignorant of the outside world.
When she encounters the male she seeks, her fangs will strike without mercy.
【Lion King's Strategy Memo】
“She's a female driven by a strong sense of mission and force. Her skills are formidable. However, once you read her purpose (pattern), her tactics will naturally become clear. Observation first!”
From official site
ナルカミという血統種の雌。
一族繁栄のため、世界最強の雄の子種を求めて各地を放浪している。
攻防共に兼ね備えた個体ではあるが、閉鎖的な地に棲息していたため、外界のことに関しては無知である。
求める雄に出会ったとき、その牙が容赦なく襲いかかってくることであろう。

segments.text: A female knight guarding an ultra-rare species in the Kingdom of Shutrend. When her master faces peril, she protects her with her very life.
Her iron-walled defense, honed through rigorous training, is as impregnable as a fortress. Yet strip away that thick armor, and tender flesh is revealed.
【Lion King's Strategy Memo】
"A classic melee type specializing in attack and defense. No need for unnecessary tricks. Overpower her head-on with brute force and show her the strength of a true warrior!"
From official site

主の危機に際しては、その身命をとして護り通す。
鍛え上げられたその鉄壁の防御は、まるで戦砦のような堅牢さを持つ。

A maid who has devoted her body and soul to her master, an ultra-rare species. An aberrant species that eliminates external threats by any means necessary. Her actions are tricky, and her loyalty to her master borders on the obsessive.
She conceals multiple powerful heavy weapons in her lower body, and when enraged, she becomes one of the most dangerous entities.
【Lion King's Strategy Memo】
"She's a total freak. But she's also one of the strongest monsters in the Manne. Long range is her domain. Get her close and attack her weak points! ………Weak points? No clue! See for yourself!"
From official site

A female skilled in alchemy said to dwell somewhere within the castle. This too is merely rumor; her existence has yet to be confirmed.
According to the tale, this female blends various materials, causing wondrous phenomena that bewilder the males. If you have any rare materials, you might be able to lure her out.
【Lion King Strategy Memo】

"A silent, expressionless being whose thoughts remain a mystery. In that case, the standard tactic is to lure them with something straightforward. I'd like to find a way to effectively utilize that ability somehow."
From official site

A female beastkin dwelling in Mig forest. Her combat prowess is virtually nonexistent, and she constantly remains vigilant of her surroundings.
Her long ears possess highly developed tactile senses, making her extremely sensitive to stimuli. The softness of her fur is said to be heavenly, and it commands high prices in trade.
【Lion King's Strategy Memo】
"Her distinctive long ears are also her weakness. Though sensitive to sound, once trapped by a snare,
she's ours to handle. Focus your attacks on those ears—her greatest asset—and the rest is automatic."

A mature female dwelling in the Hinomoto region. She is also Mao's mother. Despite having given birth, her physique shows no sign of decline whatsoever.
In fact, numerous reports indicate that the heightened allure gained through her evolution into a Mother Figure further confuses males.
In her habitat, she appears indistinguishable from ordinary females, but should she show the slightest opening, becoming prey is inevitable.
【Lion King's Strategy Memo】
"Married woman, immediate penetration—an ancient proverb passed down in both Japanese and Chinese cultures. What? You don't know it?
Who cares? Just say I made it up now. But she looks like she wouldn't hurt a fly... Still, she's a female. I get the feeling she won't be easy to handle."

A female fairy dwelling in Mig Forest. She is constantly bustling about and rarely stays in one place.
Her very presence is boisterous, and she loves to talk. Because of this, she has many friends in the forest and is well-informed.
Furthermore, fairies themselves are rare, and the honey that overflows from her body is said to possess extraordinary efficacy.

"Even I, who've faced countless formidable foes, have seldom encountered an opponent this troublesome. Keeping your distance from the real thing is your best bet."

Consequently, territorial disputes with the indigenous peoples inhabiting the same region are constant. Her physique, forged by the harsh environment of the wilderness, possesses a natural beauty.
【Lion King's Strategy Memo】
“A fierce, rampaging cow. She uses ranged attacks, so find an opening to close in for melee combat. Use those massive udders to punch a huge hole right between her legs!”
From official site

When the season comes, they receive a divine message, setting out to hunt for a mate to conceive, or performing rituals with strange smoke— their unique ecology has been reported.

“This female is eccentric in both action and thought. Trying to handle her with common sense will get you hurt. So what should you do? The answer is simple: Meet absurdity with absurdity!”

The Narukami family's navigator. Currently serving Tsubaki. Always walks around with his beloved barking pet: lhama Hiroshi.

The strongest known man, and a hunter. Male hunters hunt down women to sell to other men for reproduction -- which is a necessity, since they are usually significantly stronger than men. Women also hunt men to reproduce, but since they typically overpower men they don't need a "Hunter" to hunt for them. Sometimes the hunted and a hunter (or hunter's client) get married, but usually the hunted runs away.

After reaching a certain point in his age, Leon decided it was time for him to settled down instead of hunting down women for his clients. And so, he goes forth searching for "Good women" to be potential candidates as his bride.
Vic is his navigator and assistant.
